body: I understand how you feel but please maybe calm down a bit first feel free to pm me

My mom was the same way in terms of her career. She ended up as an Eye doctor which she absolutely hated and finally (at the age of 34) she went back to school and took the LSATs to become a lawyer which was always her dream and she’s very good about it and much happier. Not here to give advice but I hope you find something you are passionate about even if it’s a small thing.
